_help: Manual tweaks on top of the halos copied from the wiki. exclude: names to hide. aliases: extra accepted spellings. rename: change a displayed name. aspect: correct a squashed halo, as width/height (e.g. "Renge": 1.3). extra: halos the wiki doesn't have yet; upload the image to the custom/ folder and use e.g. { "name": "New Student", "group": "Playable", "url": "custom/new-student.png" }. Images from other sites are blocked for security.
